lastCompletedStory.title: Add checkClaudeAuth preflight with injectable spawn

nextStoryContext: checkClaudeAuth is now exported from src/commands/run.ts (re-export from src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts). The function is standalone and not yet wired into the runRun preflight flow -- the PRD may add a story to integrate it into cam run's startup. The implementation handles all fail-closed paths: spawn error, ENOENT (via result.error), non-zero exit, empty stdout, unparseable JSON, wrong JSON shape, loggedIn falsy. subscriptionType is surfaced but never gated. File-size budget was updated: run.ts ceiling 663->676, run-auth-preflight.ts 141, test file 208.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm: claude auth status outputs JSON by default; exits 0 when logged in, 1 when not. JSON shape includes loggedIn, authMethod, apiProvider, email, orgId, orgName, subscriptionType. Implementation gates on loggedIn===true and checks exit code, matching documented behavior.
